source.title: Generation of B(X) by two commutative subalgebras – results and open problems.

needs_review.question_text_raw: The author discusses the general problem whether B(X) can be generated by two commutative subalgebras.

evidence.quote: Let (X) be a real or complex Banach space and let (τ) be a topology on the algebra B(X) of all bounded linear operators on X. For a nonvoid subset S of B(X) let alg(S) denote the subalgebra generated by S and let alg_τ(S) denotes its τ-closure. Let u and s denote respectively the uniform and strong topology. B(X) is said to be algebraically generated by S if B(X)= alg(S), uniformly generated by S if B(X)= alg_u(S) and strongly generated by S if B(X)= alg_s(S). The author discusses the general problem whether B(X) can be generated by two commutative subalgebras. The problem concerning strong generation is already solved and the results are mentioned. The problem and the results concerning algebraic and uniform generation are discussed along with references and some historical comments.
